tasks.task: Turn a goal into a KPI tree of the few numbers that drive it

items.when: When there is a goal for the year or quarter and you need the drivers under it
When the client only reports results, to find the inputs they can control and test each
When a tree is too much for a small firm, to try a one-page sheet of seven numbers
When the tree is drafted, to find numbers that look good but do not show cause
When a number can be gamed, to pair it with a second measure that guards quality

tasks.task: Write exact metric definitions every team counts the same way

items.when: When the metrics are picked and each needs meaning, formula, grain, filters and owner
When one metric must be written as a checked definition file the data team can reuse
When two reports count the same metric differently and you need worked examples of the gap
When a number sounds clear, to ask what it really counts and what it leaves out

tasks.task: Plan what a new dashboard should measure and for whom

items.when: When someone asks for a new dashboard and you need the steps and sign-off points in order
When the request is one vague line, to ask the few questions that change the build
When you know who reads it and what they decide, to pick the metrics and a first layout
When the plan lists twenty tiles, to cut it to what the reader must see and do

tasks.task: Write a build sheet for one dashboard in the client's tool

items.when: When the plan is agreed and a builder needs sources, joins, model, measures and pages
When the tool is Power BI and you need pages, charts and filters laid out for the reader
When the client must see a working sample first, to mock it up from their data
When a page is full of gauges and colour, to keep only what helps people compare
Before go-live, to check each headline number against the accounts or source report

tasks.task: Write measures or calculated fields with a worked check

items.when: When you know the number wanted but not how to write it in the client's BI tool
Before writing a measure, to fix its grain, time window, filters and edge cases
When the measure is easier to build as a query in the client's database
When you inherit a query behind a measure and must say what it counts and keeps

tasks.task: Design the tables and joins behind a dashboard

items.when: When you need the fact and lookup tables, keys and joins written for this dashboard
When source columns must be mapped to model columns with a rule for each
When a Power BI model exists, to find risky links and tables and get a ranked fix list
When two tables are joined, to list unmatched rows and duplicate keys before totals are trusted

tasks.task: Produce a one-page weekly or monthly KPI report

items.when: When the metrics are agreed and you need five to seven numbers with trend, status and comment
When the report must rerun each week and carry a trend, a forecast and a shareable view
When the owner describes the report in plain words and wants a workbook they can rerun
When each line that moved past a set limit needs a written reason
When the report should show trend, season and odd spikes, not only this period's figure
When readers skip the tables, to try a plain weekly update with pictures instead
Before the report goes out, to catch broken formulas and totals that do not add up

tasks.task: Build a board or partner meeting pack from the numbers

items.when: When the pack needs the KPI page, the top movements and the decisions asked for
When the pack is a deck, to outline the story and where the bad news should sit
When the board must decide something and needs the evidence mapped to each decision
When the client is a charity and staff and trustees need two different views
When a long report must become one page with the answer and the decision first
Before the pack is sent, to check every slide number and chart against the workbook

tasks.task: Set up a weekly executive review sheet

items.when: When leaders want one page of at most seven numbers, each with a source and an owner
When the sheet needs a status, a comparison and one plain comment for each number
When the review covers a product, to set trends against targets and say what moved
When the sheet is drafted, to drop numbers nobody can act on

tasks.task: Find out why two numbers do not match and which to trust

items.when: When the dashboard and the accounts, or two reports, differ for the same thing
When you need the full walk from source to report with each difference explained
When a recurring report changed quietly and you must find where the definition moved
When the gap may come from a join, to list unmatched rows and duplicate keys
When the gap is between ad platforms and web analytics, to explain each difference
When the raw web analytics export and its own screen disagree on sessions or sign-ups
When one number differs between two reports, to find the step where they split

tasks.task: Review a slow, stale or ignored dashboard and list the fixes

items.when: When a dashboard is wrong, slow, stale or unused and you need ranked fixes
When a Power BI report is slow and you need a plan to test each likely cause
When wrong totals point to the model, to find risky links between tables
When one query behind the report is slow and needs a faster version
When the charts themselves may mislead, to check chart types, axes and colours

tasks.task: Run a quarterly health check on live dashboards

items.when: Each quarter, and after any change of till, CRM, booking or accounts system
When you need blanks, duplicates, broken links and stale data scored for each source
When the report is a workbook, to find stale pivots and set the refresh order
When a metric's meaning may have changed since the last check

tasks.task: Move a spreadsheet dashboard into a BI tool

items.when: When a many-tab workbook must move to a BI tool without losing its logic
Before copying any logic, to find formula errors and broken links in the old workbook
When nobody knows how the workbook works, to write down inputs, formulas and update steps
When each old column needs a home in the new model, with rules and open gaps
When the move is agreed and you need the build, test and go-live steps

tasks.task: Build pivot summaries and a monthly workbook anyone can refresh

items.when: When dated records must become a monthly summary with counts and totals you can trace
When the monthly workbook also feeds an update deck that must match it
When the workbook has several pivots and needs a safe refresh order and source checks
When you want to try cross-tabs and charts on an export quickly before building the workbook
Before the workbook is shared, to find wrong totals and broken formulas

tasks.task: Show which hours, rooms and staff sit idle from a booking export

items.when: When a salon, clinic, gym or venue wants idle hours shown by hour and day
When the heatmap or table must be drawn as a clean chart from the client's data
When quiet and busy hours are known, to fit the rota to them with a cost check
When the owner asks what unused hours cost, with idle capacity on its own line

tasks.task: Pick the right chart for each number and write its spec

items.when: When you have the data and need a clean chart of the right type
When readers should try filters or sliders, to draft an interactive version to compare
When a chart is drafted, to check the type, axes and colours do not mislead
When a chart decorates more than it compares

tasks.task: Plan a dashboard for one team: sales, marketing, HR or stock

items.when: When marketing wants short-term and long-term measures on one scorecard
When the sales view needs coverage, ageing and conversion stage by stage
When the people team needs its metrics defined and a monthly report laid out
When operations need one screen for delays, low stock and orders at risk
When an online shop wants a daily sheet of new-customer cost and profit
When a software product needs its KPIs, a layout and a way to read retention

tasks.task: Write and check the SQL behind a report

items.when: When you can say the number in plain words and need a working query for the database
Before a query feeds a live report, to find wrong-result risks and slow spots
When a query runs on a warehouse, to check joins, privacy and that it only reads
When the team wants to ask the company data and see each step behind the answer

tasks.task: Explain why a number moved

items.when: When a number moved and you must confirm it, split it by group and rank the drivers
When you only have before and after figures, to rank likely causes and what to check
When the reason must be written as a short comment beside each line
Before the explanation is shared, to mark what is proven, likely or a guess

tasks.task: Tie quarterly goals to the KPI tree

items.when: When the quarter's goals should hang off the same tree as the dashboard
When goals need clear objectives, measurable key results and a mid-quarter check
When key results are all outcomes, to swap in inputs the team can move
When there are too many goals, to find the limiting step and the right owner

tasks.task: Set targets, thresholds and alerts for key numbers

items.when: When numbers need baselines, warning levels and quiet periods so alerts stay few
Before setting a limit, to confirm the metric's window, filters and owner
When a target must allow for trend and season, not last month alone

tasks.task: Write a guide so someone else can run the report

items.when: When the report is a workbook and its next owner needs inputs, steps and risks
When you have one real run of the report and need a procedure and an exceptions guide
When the refresh needs exact steps, fixes if it fails and who to call
When the guide should say what each source table and column means

always.when: Before any build, when the request does not say who reads it or what they decide
Before any comment on the numbers goes out, to separate what is proven from guesses
Before a report or pack is sent, to catch typos and a metric named two ways

helpers.when: When the sources must be loaded into one warehouse before any dashboard can be built
When charts need accessible colours, alt text or a designed infographic or deck
When a question needs a one-off deep dive, a clean-up of messy exports or a forecast
When the source data is unreliable and needs a dictionary, quality rules or a duplicate clean-up
When the report stays in Excel or Sheets and needs complex formulas or a rebuilt workbook
When dashboard figures must tie to the management accounts line by line

gaps: No library item writes DAX measures, Data Studio calculated fields, Tableau calculations or Metabase questions; only the kit prompt covers it
No library item covers Data Studio (Looker Studio), Tableau or Metabase build or review; the only tool-specific items are three for Power BI
No library item designs a star schema or date table for reporting; only general database schema planners exist
No library item builds pivot tables or cross-tabs from an export, step by step
No library item turns a booking export into a utilisation heatmap, or proposes pricing and offers for quiet hours
No library item lists a firm's reports and usage so unused dashboards can be retired
No library item plans dashboard access, row-level security or who may see which figures
No library item drafts two or three dashboard layouts to compare before the build
No library item plans scheduled refresh, gateways or what to do when a refresh fails
No library item walks a dashboard total back to the accounts or till line by line; only the kit skill does the full tie-out
